test_PackTag: test the PackTag function to pack a field number and wire type into a protobuf tag
test_UnpackTag: test the UnpackTag function to unpack a protobuf tag into its field number and wire type
test_ZigZagEncode: test the ZigZagEncode function to encode signed integers for efficient varint protobuf encoding
test_ZigZagDecode: test the ZigZagDecode function to decode zigzag-encoded unsigned integers back to signed integers
test_ByteSizeFunctions: test all numeric ByteSize functions including Int32, Int64, UInt32, UInt64, SInt32, SInt64, Fixed32, Fixed64, SFixed32, SFixed64, Float, Double, Bool, Enum, String, Bytes, Group, Message, and MessageSetItem byte size calculations
